scenarios.when: a valid fixed loan is created
scenarios.then: the fresh row has positive face=remaining, paid=waived=0, an explicit unconditional condition and active status

scenarios.when: an imported row violates decomposition or status/clock consistency
scenarios.then: initial admission identifies the first invalid row and ordered reason without running a command

scenarios.when: a paid or forgiven row is followed by a new loan
scenarios.then: the new ID is the previous list length and the old tombstone remains exact

scenarios.when: a command targets a terminal or nonexistent row
scenarios.then: it refuses without deleting, reusing or reactivating an ID

scenarios.when: a valid imported nonempty store is admitted
scenarios.then: validity is not described as proof of historical funding

scenarios.when: conditional payoff, legal default or external truth is discussed
scenarios.then: it remains an explicit separate obligation; an arbitrary Boolean does not certify it

scenarios.when: a debtor invokes funded creation or repayment with valid cash authority

scenarios.when: a nondebtor pays or a noncreditor transfers, extends, defaults or forgives
scenarios.then: the exact role refusal preserves public state even if the actor has broad ledger/admin permissions

scenarios.when: the current creditor transfers an active or defaulted claim
scenarios.then: the debtor, face, amounts, due, condition and default history remain unchanged

scenarios.when: the creditor extends an active due date
scenarios.then: newDue is strictly later and at least now; principal and cash remain exact

scenarios.when: a defaulted claim is extended or a transfer names the debtor
scenarios.then: the action refuses; no cure, self-payment claim or debtor novation occurs

scenarios.when: the creditor forgives an active or defaulted remainder
scenarios.then: remaining becomes0, waived increases by the old remainder, paid is unchanged and status is terminal forgiven

scenarios.when: forgiveness is reported as repayment
scenarios.then: the full status/paid/waived/receipt oracle rejects that report

scenarios.when: default is requested exactly at due and one tick later
scenarios.then: the first refuses and the second records default without erasing debt

scenarios.when: a defaulted claim receives partial or complete late repayment
scenarios.then: payment remains allowed and defaultAt survives partial/defaulted or terminal/paid status

scenarios.when: a stale row revision and unauthorized actor occur together
scenarios.then: revision refusal wins under the declared precedence

scenarios.when: a lifecycle boundary time decreases
scenarios.then: clock refusal precedes lookup; legacy execution retains its old timestamp behavior

scenarios.when: a debtor borrows10 from a funded creditor
scenarios.then: one command publishes cash movement and exactly one face10 claim

scenarios.when: funding is missing or has the wrong amount or source
scenarios.then: the candidate receipt fails exact shape and neither funds nor a claim are published

scenarios.when: 10 outstanding is repaid4 then6
scenarios.then: the first leaves remaining6/paid4 and the second yields terminal paid with paid10 and actual cash restored

scenarios.when: the creditor changed before repayment
scenarios.then: cash reaches the current creditor; historical payments retain their own event creditor

scenarios.when: repayment is zero, negative or exceeds remaining
scenarios.then: the ordered amount refusal preserves ledger and liability

scenarios.when: a successful inner invocation pays from another party, to another creditor, or in another asset
scenarios.then: paymentMismatch retains the tentative diagnostic and publishes no state change

scenarios.when: a successful inner invocation adds supply or an extra balanced transfer
scenarios.then: exact all-cell/supply checks reject it despite a plausible headline payment

scenarios.when: the registered invocation refuses for authority or insufficient funds
scenarios.then: the exact underlying Composition failure is retained without a claim mutation

scenarios.when: execution succeeds but subsequent payment validation fails
scenarios.then: public world, claims, outputs and events remain at entry while the failure records the actual tentative result

scenarios.when: cash or claim publication is individually omitted
scenarios.then: the independently expected full-state oracle rejects the incomplete result

scenarios.when: metadata and payment commands share a sequence
scenarios.then: metadata consumes an absolute index without inventing outputs; payment uses the actual prior output history

scenarios.when: a command refuses after a successful prefix
scenarios.then: only located failure is added and every subsequent command is skipped

scenarios.when: continueRun is split at an arbitrary entry cursor
scenarios.then: append equality preserves the whole cursor without reinitialization

scenarios.when: a reachable existing liability decreases
scenarios.then: an actual debtor payment or creditor forgiveness accounts for exactly that decrease

scenarios.when: default, transfer, extension or legacy execution occurs
scenarios.then: remaining/paid/waived stay unchanged and every other row remains exact

scenarios.when: a trace starts with empty claims and creates loans
scenarios.then: every appended row has an actual funding-event witness, not merely an assumed well-formed row

scenarios.when: an arbitrary legacy cursor including prior failure is embedded
scenarios.then: legacy continuation preserves its exact old events, history, world, index and failure

scenarios.when: a mixed lifecycle trace is projected
